reviews.t: Great for those with dry scalp!
reviews.x: I often suffer from dry or itchy scalp and this shampoo had really helped soothe those symptoms for me. I recommend this to anyone looking for an occasional option to help shine up and moisturize their hair. I do not recommend using this as a daily shampoo option because it will lead to oily hair rather quick. I realized this after using this exclusively for a week straight. If you have oily hair, I would recommend every third wash otherwise, highly recommend!

reviews.x: The low stars are because either the seller watered down my shampoo or they changed the formula. It used to be thick and get luxurious. Now I don’t even feel it getting my hair clean. A bottle used to last me forever but this watery shampoo isn’t going to last. It’s no longer a great value nor does it moisturize the same watered down.

claims.text: Many reviewers report their hair is growing thicker or filling in after using the shampoo and conditioner, often alongside other products like castor oil.
Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as pleasant and grape-fruity.
Several reviewers say the shampoo leaves hair clean and helps with dry or itchy scalp, though some note it can leave hair feeling dry or oily if overused.
A few reviewers complain the product arrived watered down or with a changed formula, making it thin and less effective.
Some reviewers mention it caused dandruff or made their hair feel dry, requiring conditioner to soften it.
